name: Luminar Neo
summary: A photo editing software with AI features like Sky Replacement, Portrait Enhancer, and Structure AI.
description:
A photo editing software with AI features like Sky Replacement, Portrait Enhancer, and Structure AI. Download Luminar Neo - photo editing software for PC and Mac! Simple photo editor with AI that helps edit your photos as you imagine it in your eyes

Sky Replacement: Instantly swap skies in your photos with AI. Portrait Enhancer: Automatically improve skin, eyes, and facial features. Structure AI: Enhance image details while preserving people and objects. Relight AI: Intelligently relight your scene for balanced exposure.
